candidates.change_summary: Replace the hardcoded target address with a different address so external call goes to a different contract.
Remove the low-level call entirely so no external call happens, changing the balance after go.
Change the value sent in the low-level call to zero instead of msg.value.
Change the owner transfer from transferring the entire balance to a fixed amount, altering the final state.
Delete the owner transfer so after go the contract retains all balance.
Delete the revert on failure so execution continues even if the external call fails.
